title: Case-Inflected Relative Pronouns: akinek, amiről, amelyben

sections.title: Inflecting Relative Pronouns with Suffixes and Postpositions
sections.content: Relative pronouns take case endings depending on their grammatical function in the subordinate clause: *akinek* (dative: to whom / whose), *amelyben* (inessive: in which), *amiről* (delative: about which), *ahová* (lative: whereto).

items.spanish: A városrész, amelyben lakunk, az utóbbi években sokat fejlődött.
items.english: The district in which we live has developed a lot in recent years.

items.spanish: Találkoztunk egy idős lakossal, akinek a családja évszázadok óta itt él.
items.english: We met an elderly resident whose family has lived here for centuries.

items.spanish: A polgármester arról a tervről beszélt, amiről tegnap az újságok is írtak.
items.english: The mayor spoke about the plan about which the newspapers also wrote yesterday.
